Password protected high Encryption CD/DVD writing software

If you think you need encryption, why on earth trust a proprietary closed-source solution? You have zero assurance that it doesn't have a dozen back doors.

Encrypt your files using trusted open source tools that have been vetted by thousands of users (gnupg would be a good starting point). Check that you've actually downloaded a valid, uncompromised copy by verifying MD5 sums. Then burn your CDs/DVDs using any of the dozens (hundreds?) of CD-burning tools out there.

Using a product like this is foolish practice and security theater at best. The only person you can trust to do your homework is you.
